metadata.description: Single-skill marketplace: maintain a per-project Product Backlog and HTML dashboard from Claude session activity.

plugins.name: product-backlog
plugins.description: Analyzes the current Claude session — git commits, plans, PRDs, opportunities-marked-DONE, conversational signals — and updates docs/backlog/product-backlog.md with atomic rows, status sections, stable IDs, and append-only artifact links. Also bootstraps a self-contained HTML dashboard (regenerated only on template version bumps) and offers a commit/push prompt at the end.
